question: Where was the National Maritime Games 2025 inaugurated by the President of the Indian Olympic Association and Member of Parliament Dr. P.T. Usha?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Navi Mumbai**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Padma Shri Dr. P.T. Usha, President of the Indian Olympic Association and Member of Parliament, inaugurated the National Maritime Games 2025 at the Indian Maritime University (IMU), Palm Beach Road, Navi Mumbai on March 24, 2025.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The National Maritime Games 2025 was flagged off in Navi Mumbai by Dr. P.T. Usha.**
 
• **Venue: Indian Maritime University, Palm Beach Road, Navi Mumbai.**
 
• **Event features 20+ sports including swimming, TT, athletics, futsal, etc.**
 
• **Games promote sportsmanship, unity, and fitness in India’s maritime community.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **National Maritime Games 2025**__

 
 
• Inaugurated by Dr. P.T. Usha, an iconic Indian athlete and Rajya Sabha MP.
 
• Organized with support from the Shipping Corporation of India, Indian Coast Guard, PSA India, and others.
 
• K2K Sports Management led the planning and execution of the event.
 
• Events held across venues, including Thakur International Sports Complex for swimming and table tennis.
